positioning.statement: For owner-led landscape companies with 5-40 people who design, install and maintain residential landscapes, Rootline is the landscape business operating system that takes every job from first photo to to-scale design to signed proposal to crew schedule to paid invoice to closed books, with a regional horticulturist's plant knowledge built in. Unlike generalist home-service apps (Jobber, Housecall Pro), estimating-first landscape tools (LMN, SynkedUP, SingleOps) or enterprise platforms (Aspire, Real Green), Rootline designs, sells, runs and accounts for the work in one system, at a published price, with zero payment markup.
taglines: From first sketch to closed books.
Design it. Sell it. Grow it.
The whole landscape business, rooted in one place.

segments.name: Solo / micro mow-and-maintain
pains: Paying all year for a seasonal business

message.headline: Your route, your invoices and your money, in your pocket.
message.subhead: Starter runs a mow-and-maintain business from one phone: today's route, invoices from the truck and card or autopay on your own Stripe. $69 a month on annual.

pillars: Run the whole business in one place
proof_points_to_verify: Active field seats: pay for winter helpers only when they work (22 §4.3)
Snow Lite included in every plan (22 §4.5)
segments.offer: Free 14-day trial (30 days Nov-Feb), no card required
objections: I only have a few clients
Starter is priced for 1-6 people and Snow Lite is included, so winter plowing is covered too.
I already use a free app
Free apps stop at the schedule. Starter adds autopay on your own Stripe and a real ledger, so tax time is one export.
